Fetch IMF commodity-prices page and locate downloadable Excel database link: $ python3 - <<'PY' import re, requests url='https://www.imf.org/en/research/commodity-prices' html=requests.get(url,timeout=30).text # find excel links links=re.findall(r'href="([^"]+\.(?:xls|xlsx|xlsm)(?:\?[^"]*)?)"',html,re.I) print('found',len(links)) for l in links[:50]:     print(l) # also .ashx maybe links2=re.findall(r'href="([^"]+CommodityPrices[^"]+)"',html,re.I) print('CommodityPrices patterns',len(links2)) for l in links2[:20]:     print(l) PY

Inspect IMF external-data.xlsx sheets and locate gold price column: $ python3 - <<'PY' from openpyxl import load_workbook wb=load_workbook('/root/data/imf/external-data.xlsx', data_only=False) print('Sheets:', wb.sheetnames) # check first sheet structure ws=wb[wb.sheetnames[0]] print('first sheet title',ws.title,'max_row',ws.max_row,'max_col',ws.max_column) # search for 'Gold' header in first 20 rows import re for r in range(1,25):     vals=[ws.cell(r,c).value for c in range(1,ws.max_column+1)]     if any(isinstance(v,str) and 'Gold' in v for v in vals):         print('row',r,'goldish',[(i+1,v) for i,v in enumerate(vals) if isinstance(v,str) and 'Gold' in v][:10])         break PY

View IMF external sheet header rows and date column samples: $ python3 - <<'PY' from openpyxl import load_workbook wb=load_workbook('/root/data/imf/external-data.xlsx') ws=wb['External'] for r in range(1,6):     print(r,[ws.cell(r,c).value for c in range(1,10)]) # find date values in column 1/2 for rows 3-10 for col in [1,2]:     print('col',col,'rows3-10:',[ws.cell(r,col).value for r in range(3,11)]) PY

Find start of date rows in Value, Volume, Total Reserves sheets: $ python3 - <<'PY' from openpyxl import load_workbook wb=load_workbook('/root/data/test-rar.xlsx', data_only=False) for sheet in ['Value','Volume','Total Reserves']:     ws=wb[sheet]     # find first row where col A looks like date string e.g. 'Jan-2003'     first=None     for r in range(1,ws.max_row+1):         v=ws.cell(r,1).value         if isinstance(v,str) and ('-' in v) and len(v)>=7 and v[0].isalpha():             first=r; break     print(sheet,'max_row',ws.max_row,'max_col',ws.max_column,'first_date_row',first,'first_date',ws.cell(first,1).value if first else None)     if first:         for r in range(first, first+5):             print(' ',r,[ws.cell(r,c).value for c in range(1,6)]) PY

Print all rows in Value sheet to see date/value data locations: $ python3 - <<'PY' from openpyxl import load_workbook wb=load_workbook('/root/data/test-rar.xlsx', data_only=False) ws=wb['Value'] for r in range(1,ws.max_row+1):     vals=[ws.cell(r,c).value for c in range(1,10)]     print(r,vals) PY

Search Total Reserves sheet headers for countries from Volume list: $ python3 - <<'PY' from openpyxl import load_workbook wb=load_workbook('/root/data/test-rar.xlsx', data_only=False) ws=wb['Total Reserves'] headers=[(c,ws.cell(1,c).value) for c in range(1,ws.max_column+1)] for term in ['Uzbek','Czech','Slovak','Latvia','Belarus','Georgia']:     hits=[(c,h) for c,h in headers if isinstance(h,str) and term.lower() in h.lower()]     print(term,'hits',hits[:5]) PY

Populate gold prices, add formulas, and fill Answer sheet tables: $ python3 - <<'PY' from openpyxl import load_workbook from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter from openpyxl.styles import numbers  TEMPLATE='/root/data/test-rar.xlsx' IMF='/root/data/imf/external-data.xlsx' OUT='/root/output/rar_result.xlsx'  # --- Load IMF gold price series --- imf_wb=load_workbook(IMF, data_only=True) imf_ws=imf_wb['External']  gold_col=None gold_desc_sub='Gold, Fixing Committee of the London Bullion Market Association' for c in range(1, imf_ws.max_column+1):     v=imf_ws.cell(2,c).value     if isinstance(v,str) and gold_desc_sub in v:         gold_col=c         gold_desc=v         break if gold_col is None:     raise SystemExit('Could not find gold series column in IMF file')  # data rows start at row 5 (based on file structure) price_by_period={} for r in range(5, imf_ws.max_row+1):     period=imf_ws.cell(r,1).value     if not isinstance(period,str) or 'M' not in period:         continue     val=imf_ws.cell(r,gold_col).value     if val is None:         continue     price_by_period[period]=float(val)  # --- Load template workbook --- wb=load_workbook(TEMPLATE) ws_gold=wb['Gold price']  # Fill prices for r in range(2, ws_gold.max_row+1):     period=ws_gold.cell(r,1).value     if isinstance(period,str) and period in price_by_period:         cell=ws_gold.cell(r,2)         cell.value=price_by_period[period]         cell.number_format='0.00'  # Add formulas for log returns and vols for r in range(2, ws_gold.max_row+1):     # C: monthly log return (percent)     if r == 2:         ws_gold.cell(r,3).value = ''     else:         ws_gold.cell(r,3).value = f'=IF(OR(B{r}="",B{r-1}=""),"",LN(B{r}/B{r-1})*100)'     ws_gold.cell(r,3).number_format='0.00'      # D: 3-month volatility of monthly log returns (percent)     if r < 5:         ws_gold.cell(r,4).value = ''     else:         ws_gold.cell(r,4).value = f'=IF(COUNT(C{r-2}:C{r})<3,"",STDEV.S(C{r-2}:C{r}))'     ws_gold.cell(r,4).number_format='0.00'      # E: 12-month volatility of monthly log returns (percent)     if r < 14:         ws_gold.cell(r,5).value = ''     else:         ws_gold.cell(r,5).value = f'=IF(COUNT(C{r-11}:C{r})<12,"",STDEV.S(C{r-11}:C{r}))'     ws_gold.cell(r,5).number_format='0.00'  # --- Answer sheet --- ws_ans=wb['Answer']  # Step 1 ws_ans['C3'].value = '=NORM.S.INV(0.95)' ws_ans['C4'].value = '=INDEX(\'Gold price\'!D:D, MATCH("2025M9",\'Gold price\'!A:A,0))' ws_ans['C5'].value = '=C4*SQRT(12)' ws_ans['C6'].value = '=INDEX(\'Gold price\'!E:E, MATCH("2025M9",\'Gold price\'!A:A,0))' for addr in ['C3','C4','C5','C6']:     ws_ans[addr].number_format='0.000'  # Helper: Jan-Sep 2025 avg gold price (embedded formula fragment) avg_2025_jan_sep = 'AVERAGE(INDEX(\'Gold price\'!$B:$B, MATCH("2025M1",\'Gold price\'!$A:$A,0)):INDEX(\'Gold price\'!$B:$B, MATCH("2025M9",\'Gold price\'!$A:$A,0)))'  # Step 2 (place countries horizontally starting at column C) step2_cols = ['C','D','E','F','G','H'] step2_countries = ['Belarus','Georgia','Uzbekistan','Czechia','Slovakia','Latvia']  for col, country in zip(step2_cols, step2_countries):     ws_ans[f'{col}11'].value = country  # Values (millions USD) ws_ans['C12'].value = '=Value!D18' ws_ans['D12'].value = '=Value!F18' ws_ans['E12'].value = f'=Volume!F18*({avg_2025_jan_sep})' ws_ans['F12'].value = f'=Volume!G18*({avg_2025_jan_sep})' ws_ans['G12'].value = f'=Volume!H18*({avg_2025_jan_sep})' ws_ans['H12'].value = f'=Volume!I18*({avg_2025_jan_sep})'  for col in step2_cols:     ws_ans[f'{col}12'].number_format='0.0'  # Exposure: 95% one-sided shock over 3-month horizon shock_3m = '($C$3*$C$5*SQRT(3/12))/100' for col in step2_cols:     ws_ans[f'{col}13'].value = f'=IF({col}12="","",{col}12*{shock_3m})'     ws_ans[f'{col}13'].number_format='0.0'  # Step 3 (exclude Slovakia if Total Reserves missing) step3_cols = ['C','D','E','F','G'] # map from step2 columns to step3 columns (skip Slovakia at step2 G) step3_from_step2 = {'C':'C','D':'D','E':'E','F':'F','G':'H'}  # G in step3 comes from H in step2 (Latvia)  for col3, col2 in step3_from_step2.items():     ws_ans[f'{col3}20'].value = f'={col2}11'     ws_ans[f'{col3}21'].value = f'={col2}12'     ws_ans[f'{col3}22'].value = f'={col2}13'     ws_ans[f'{col3}21'].number_format='0.0'     ws_ans[f'{col3}22'].number_format='0.0'  # Total reserves lookup (2025 row is row 18) for col in step3_cols:     ws_ans[f'{col}23'].value = f'=IFERROR(INDEX(\'Total Reserves\'!$18:$18, MATCH("*"&{col}20&"*",\'Total Reserves\'!$1:$1,0)),"")'     ws_ans[f'{col}23'].number_format='0.0'  # RaR as percent of total reserves for col in step3_cols:     ws_ans[f'{col}24'].value = f'=IF({col}23="","",{col}22/{col}23)'     ws_ans[f'{col}24'].number_format='0.0%'  # Save wb.save(OUT) print('Wrote',OUT) PY

Patch Answer formulas for LibreOffice compatibility and clear Volume #N/A cell: $ python3 - <<'PY' from openpyxl import load_workbook path='/root/output/rar_result.xlsx' wb=load_workbook(path) # Fix Answer step1 formulas ws=wb['Answer'] ws['C3'].value = 1.6448536269514722  # 95% one-sided z ws['C3'].number_format='0.000' # direct last-row references (Gold price ends at 2025M9 in row 430) ws['C4'].value = "='Gold price'!D430" ws['C4'].number_format='0.000' ws['C5'].value = '=C4*SQRT(12)' ws['C5'].number_format='0.000' ws['C6'].value = "='Gold price'!E430" ws['C6'].number_format='0.000'  # Clear known #N/A literal in Volume sheet ws_vol=wb['Volume'] if ws_vol['E15'].value == '#N/A':     ws_vol['E15'].value = None  wb.save(path) print('patched',path) PY

Replace STDEV.S with STDEV and clear Volume #N/A formula cell: $ python3 - <<'PY' from openpyxl import load_workbook path='/root/output/rar_result.xlsx' wb=load_workbook(path) ws_gold=wb['Gold price'] # Replace volatility formulas to use STDEV (Excel-compatible, LO-compatible) for r in range(2, ws_gold.max_row+1):     d=ws_gold.cell(r,4).value     e=ws_gold.cell(r,5).value     if isinstance(d,str) and 'STDEV.S' in d.upper():         ws_gold.cell(r,4).value = d.replace('STDEV.S','STDEV').replace('stdev.s','STDEV')     if isinstance(e,str) and 'STDEV.S' in e.upper():         ws_gold.cell(r,5).value = e.replace('STDEV.S','STDEV').replace('stdev.s','STDEV')  # Clear Volume!E15 which is a formula returning #N/A ws_vol=wb['Volume'] ws_vol['E15'].value = None  wb.save(path) print('patched',path) PY
